svg.aria-label: About. Data and business analyst based in Harare, Zimbabwe, combining insurance and pensions expertise with data analytics, automation and software development to solve practical business problems. My approach is end to end. Not every problem needs AI or complex software. The goal is to find the right solution for the job. Nine years in insurance and pensions operations; MSc Big Data Analytics; BCom (Honours) Risk Management and Insurance; founder of MorTech.
